primary_recommendation: Small scientific control layer + direct standard research tools + conditional LEAN integration; no wholesale migration; Nautilus alternative benchmark

subsystem_decisions.implementation_and_boundary: Retain raw-byte hashes, clock distinctions, accession/class bindings, append-only decisions and fail-closed semantics. Use standard SQLite/object storage; do not grow a proprietary database platform.

Qualify a maintained reference backbone as in the red review; retain small temporal crosswalk/admission adapters. Buy maintenance of the universe rather than recreate it from current symbols/ITCH. No vendor is newly admitted here.
Preserve registered population/class selection, exact lookbacks, protected hashes, unresolved states, candidate ordering and no-replacement rules.
Retain bounded original-envelope capture and completeness guards; use SEC APIs and maintained HTTP tooling. No current-ticker lookup as historical identity.
EdgarTools for parsing/crosschecks from captured accession-bound data after acceptance fixtures. Keep our raw-span/period/entity verifier; stop building a universal SEC/XBRL parser.
Official qualified provider SDKs/bulk tooling, keeping native symbols/time/precision and raw-response evidence where required. Source contracts/entitlements remain independent of engine defaults.

Official agency APIs/archives, ALFRED vintages and a qualified historical news source; source-specific availability/revision adapter beneath the same evidence layer. No autonomous browsing-to-trade shortcut.

scikit-learn Pipeline, Ridge and the registered squared-loss depth-2 boosted-tree implementation/grid. Fit preprocessing only on training rows. Use existing numerical libraries, not custom ML estimators.
Registered shared passages, deterministic comparisons, source-span/entity/unit checks, schema validation and abstention. Adopt ordinary parser/model SDK primitives underneath.

Official model clients and structured output validation. One bounded extractor plus permitted repair; no generic multi-agent framework needed for a fixed extraction stage. Model choice remains removable.
LLM facts become reviewed features in the same estimator/risk pipeline as controls. Preserve fixed opportunities, models, budgets and information boundaries. Avoid vote-based trade committees.
RD-Agent(Q)/Qlib in an isolated later research experiment. Do not custom-build a proposal/code/evaluate/repair loop.
Local/private MLflow; log all trials/failures/costs and link immutable input/registration hashes. Mutable tracker rows are not scientific authority.
DVC/content-addressed manifests and private versioned storage when scale needs it. Evidence timing/rights remain separate; do not commit licensed data.
Parquet and DuckDB views over versioned evidence/features. Preserve quote precision and temporal joins; no new feature-store service yet.
Qualified LEAN adapter, including registered fills/costs/terminal treatment. Retain the tiny existing replay only as a regression oracle.
Registered paired incremental net metric, controls, purging/grouping, failures/abstentions, trial budgets, holdout and promotion rules. Adopt statistical/bootstrap primitives.
Maintained engine accounting/reservations/risk hooks; retain our exact deterministic limits, halt and scheduled-exit policy. Prototype defaults are not the registered production policy.
Selected engine's order states, partial-fill/cancel handling, dedup/reconciliation capabilities. Keep only a small project approval/intent boundary and acceptance checks. Do not build a generic OMS.
Maintained selected-engine plugin after license, Paper and fault-recovery qualification. Existing read-only broker probes remain diagnostics.
Engine reconciliation plus standard metrics/logging/OpenTelemetry. Keep source/economic/cost/unknown-state alerts. A successful snapshot is not continuous reconciliation.

DVC stages for dependency/cache reuse; Prefect for durable scheduled retries/pause/resume when unattended work requires it. Never implement a generic scheduler or confuse cache reuse with scientific replay.
Use a framework's checkpointing, or LangGraph if a new bounded graph is genuinely needed. No second graph engine in the minimal fixed extraction path.
Existing official-runner qualification plan, trusted-base guards, exact-SHA CI and independent review. Current real-provider activation remains PAUSED_BUDGET; no new agent platform/router.

Platform secret isolation, least-privilege jobs, locked dependencies/containers and sandbox controls; keep project-specific access/cost/approval policy. No broker/acquisition secrets in research coding agents.

cost_limits: No spending authorization. Vendor quotes and future budget approval remain separate. Current OSS code licenses do not confer data/model/broker/service rights.
known_limits: Static inspection only; no upstream install/runtime/benchmark
Some primary routes source-limited; current positive requests preserved
Qlib Git-vs-PyPI/Nautilus stable-vs-development must be pinned separately
Commercial engine internals not inspected; pricing/entitlements/retention require exact terms
Current acquisition gate unchanged; no framework admission for performance or execution
